name: OCA SwapHelper sellOCA recycles the sold OCA out of the OCA/USDC pair
summary: SwapHelper.sellOCA sells the caller's OCA into the OCA/USDC pair for USDC, then calls OCA.recycle to pull the same OCA back out of the pair and sync, so sales drain USDC while the OCA reserve shrinks. The attacker bought OCA untaxed by flash-swapping it from the pair (OCA's remove-liquidity heuristic skips the 100% buy tax) and cycled buy/sellOCA.
notes: Two defect-bearing contracts: the SwapHelper (sellOCA recycle) and OCAToken (_isRemoveLiquidity treats an optimistic flash-swap buy as liquidity removal, and recycle lets the helper move pair balance). The token's setSwapHelper grant to this helper, made after both deployments, enabled recycle and sets the age.

Loss is the pair's USDC depletion in the anchor and a copycat by a different actor; flash loans and buy legs return within each tx. The pair's OCA, recycled to the mining pool and DEAD, is the same liquidity and is not added. Copycat selection: OCA transfers out of the pair to non-fee, non-helper addresses after the helper deployment (Etherscan logs to block 82000000).
